verdict.rationale: Graphite is a SaaS developer platform with an API-adjacent surface: a CLI, an MCP server, GitHub App integration and agents. A sandbox or test environment is a fair thing to ask of such a product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolated environment for trying features or agents without touching production repositories or data. Agents opening draft PRs and AI reviews on real repos do not amount to a sandbox.
